answer: Bilingual speakers switch languages at characteristic moments, and the transition timing forms a profile. A farm needs 430 distinct switch patterns, since one person's code-switching cannot cover 430 aliases. The pattern is re-measured each epoch, and the transition timing must match the enrolled profile. The inlet check runs in the open: 430 fakes pay the full price 430 times, one honest agent pays once, and the pulse trail in the ledger makes the violet cost visible to everyone.
